Selection: Select and move layers or handles in the viewer. Start here to arrange a composition.
Hand: Pan the viewer without moving any layers.
Zoom: Magnify or reduce the viewer; the render resolution does not change.
Orbit: Rotate the viewing angle around the cursor in a 3D scene.
PanCamera: Move the camera view sideways or vertically.
Dolly: Move the camera toward or away from the cursor.
Rotate: Rotate a selected layer around its anchor point.
PanBehind: Move the anchor point that controls the center of rotation and scaling.
Rectangle: Draw a rectangular shape or mask.
RoundedRect: Draw a rectangle with rounded corners.
Ellipse: Draw an ellipse or circular shape or mask.
Polygon: Draw a shape with multiple straight sides.
Star: Draw a star with adjustable points.
Pen: Place vertices and drag handles to create curved paths and masks.
PenAdd: Add a vertex to an existing path for more control.
PenDelete: Remove a vertex from a path.
PenConvert: Change a vertex between a corner and a curved point.
MaskFeather: Adjust how softly a mask blends into its surroundings.
Type: Create and edit horizontal text in a composition.
TypeVertical: Create and edit vertically arranged text.
Brush: Paint strokes on a layer; inspect brush options before drawing.
Clone: Copy pixels from a sampled source region to another area.
Eraser: Erase painted or image regions; work on a duplicate while learning.
RotoBrush: Mark a subject to separate it from the background; results depend on footage and model settings.
RefineEdge: Improve a roto boundary around detailed edges such as hair.
ObjectMatte: Select an object with a click or box to create a subject matte; inspect the result.
Puppet: Add position pins and move them to deform a layer.
PuppetStarch: Add stiffness to reduce deformation in a region.
PuppetBend: Control local rotation and scale around a bend pin.
PuppetAdvanced: Combine position, rotation and scale control in one pin.
PuppetOverlap: Control which parts appear in front when deformed regions overlap.
